messages:
Avery: Opening a short follow-up thread for any quick questions on today's leadership session (mission, market positioning, competitors, roadmap). Keep them punchy and we'll answer.

Nina: Two-parter: 1) should SEs highlight our model catalog curation or runtime optimizations first in demos? 2) do we have an exportability line for procurement worried about lock-in?

Sam: 1) demo flow: start with the model catalog to show breadth & verified profiles, then flip to runtime optimizations to show predictable latency & cost. 2) exportability: yes  we have a migration/mirroring playbook (model weights & runtimes can be exported; configs are JSON). Emphasize model version pinning and data portability.

Riya: Quick note on messaging: for engineer audiences, lead with developer ergonomics and low-friction SDKs. For buyer/procurement, lead with auditability, KMS integration, and exit options.

Kunal: Competitor question: if cloud vendors bundle cheap GPUs with opaque autoscale, what do we surface as the real risk?

Sam: Risk = unpredictable tail latency and hidden costs from inefficient batching + cold KV cache misses. Our counterpoint: deterministic SLOs, explicit error budgets, and cost-visibility per-route.

Nina: Are error budgets something we should mention publicly or just in enterprise proposals?

Avery: Keep error budgets in enterprise conversations and SE playbooks for now. Publicly, highlight SLOs and SLA commitments.

Kunal: Roadmap ask: where does model quantization recommendation tooling sit? I heard a spike on that.

Riya: Optimize features (quantization recommendations, batching hints) are Q3 experimental, Q4 GA for Dedicated. We'll prioritize model families based on customer usage signals first.

Nina: Any new collateral for partner/channel teams? Partners want a short tech one-pager + commercial bullets.

Sam: Partner pack: one-pager + 2 slide deck + migration checklist. SEs/partners will get it next Tuesday. It includes a short RFP appendix covering KMS, SLAs, and private deployment options.

Avery: Legal asked to add a standard data flow diagram to the partner pack. Riya, can you coordinate with Legal?

Riya: On it.

Kunal: Quick demo tip: how to show fallback policy without full tracing?

Sam: Use this minimal demo config and the CLI replay: ```json
{"route":"demo-serve","fallback":["rwd-base","rwd-small"],"latency_slo_ms":180}
``` then replay synthetic traffic to trigger fallback and capture per-request logs.

deploy-bot: slides-uploaded to #docs at 1812345720 :white_check_mark:

Nina: Last one  any short phrase we should use in public blog copy to capture our differentiation vs self-hosted + cloud?

Avery: Try: "Self-host grade control, hosted ease, and predictable inference economics." Short and signals the three pillars.

Sam: If anyone needs more tactical objection handlers or a short script for calls, DM me; I'll share the new one-pager when it lands.

Avery: Great thread  leaving open for 48h. If anything sensitive, DM me or Legal. Cheers! :sparkles:
